about: Reviewed corrections of the BDH labels (labels v2), applied by tools/labels/apply_label_changes.py to the original split's annotations_fixed files (tools/labels/make_labels_v2.sh). Per split, in the order they are applied; a building is named by orig_id and its tile. height_from: review (the reviewer's floor count or value), parallax (from the length of the roof-footprint offset on the review page), model (a model's prediction the reviewer took), literature (a published height); offset_from: review (drawn or typed), suggested (the review page's suggestion), model. Review of 2026-10-10, corrections decided on 2026-10-12.
